name: StockAI - imminent stockout to a Jira issue

parameters.content:
StockAI event: stockout.imminent (sent once when a SKU enters the state, not every day).

Create a webhook in StockAI subscribed to stockout.imminent, set STOCKAI_WEBHOOK_SECRET, choose the Jira project and issue type, and select your Jira credentials.

Not yet imported into a live n8n by the authors: check each node after importing.
